notes:
• Card sorting: box labels and receipts now have a UPC barcode instead of a QR code — scan it with any barcode scanner into the order search to pull the order up
• New sort workflow inside an order: status steps across the top, then each sort pass with ▶ Start on machine / ■ Finish pass (cards that went through) or ✓ Done by hand. Progress fills in by itself and finishing the last pass moves the order to Sorting Complete; the first pass's machine count becomes the actual card count
• Square invoice → ✉ Email pay link: sends the invoice in Square (after you turn on Partial payments there) and emails the customer the pay link from the store's email (Settings → Email)
